correctness.rationale: For s≥3 and 0<ℓ≤min a_i/2, adjacent forbidden coordinate events cannot coexist. Inclusion-exclusion therefore ranges over matchings of the cyclic edge graph; each unoccupied vertex gives M_i and edge gives B_i, and the two-state 2x2 cyclic transfer trace equals the signed sum. In homogeneous case diagonalization at fixed r>0 yields exact MGF, mean s/2 by reflection, explicit finite variance and asymptotic σ²>1/12. The smaller eigenvalue ratio is uniformly <1 for real tilt and analyticity of Λ gives MGF CLT and Gärtner-Ellis LDP. At endpoints 0/1, asymptotics log m(t) show infinite rate. An independent direct matching enumeration matched trace for s=3,4,6 at distinct t, including zero. These are corroborations; infinite s follows analytically.

originality.rationale: Original chainlink-volume trace at t=0 and combinatorial matching method are prior art (Kantarcı Oğuz–Özel–Ravichandran Prop 6.8). This statement upgrades to all real exponential tilts and complete continuous section mass transform, exact variance, CLT and large-deviation rate. Earlier fence-poset rank polynomials are discrete counts. Untilted volume equality does not imply derivatives at nonzero tilt nor asymptotic fluctuation laws.
